reproduced.summary: e2e/code-contrast.spec.ts runs once in the dark theme and once in the light theme. It sends a message that the fake engine echoes back as markdown with inline code and a fenced code block. For both kinds of code it asserts four things: the computed `color-scheme` matches the theme, the colour equals the theme's `--foreground`, contrast is at least 4.5:1, and every request stays on localhost:5199. It should fail now because nothing sets `color-scheme`, so the computed value is "normal" and not "dark"/"light". The colour and contrast checks also catch the reported dark grey if Chrome's computed colour shows it. I haven't been able to run it.
